scope: GF8 legacy-high AVX2 ordinary and one-item-batch encode for K=8, R=3 or 4, and exactly 1024-byte shards

changes: Extend the packed T=4 selector to exactly K=8, R=3 or 4, and B=1024 while preserving the existing disjoint K=4/B=1024 case.
Reuse the already-qualified K=8/R=3 and K=8/R=4 AVX2 callback bodies without adding or changing a backend kernel.
Keep K=5 through K=7 at B=1024 and K=8 at B=1023, B=1025, and B=2048 on the mature fallback.
Keep K=8 excluded from reusable multi-item T=4 binding; only ordinary encode and the one-item batch wrapper select this terminal.
Add an internal setup-only diagnostic selector and benchmark-only symmetric mode argument so one immutable shared-inode executable can provide the same-source fallback attribution.

authoritative_campaign.performance_statistic: geometric mean of one balanced log contrast per independent ABBA round with two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence intervals

rejected_predecessor_campaigns.reason_rejected: Separate candidate and control ELFs produced impossible same-path K<8 differences from 0.7795x through 2.2193x despite identical executable code for those cells; executable/page placement invalidated attribution.

Shared-inode attribution removed ELF placement bias, but only the control received an extra command-line argument; a 1.02306x same-path control violated the two-percent gate. The final run supplies equal-count, equal-length mode arguments to both sides.

static_evidence.diagnostic_growth_explanation: The timing-only benchmark CLI adds 402 executable bytes and link alignment adds 46; production leopard2.cpp.o adds 64 bytes, including the 27-byte setup-only diagnostic setter. The promotion limit is applied to production library code, not evidence-harness CLI code; the larger diagnostic ELF is explicitly not claimed to pass it.

correctness_and_build_gates.evidence_scope: Session-observed command results; authoritative timing and provenance are retained separately above.

correctness_and_build_gates.strict_gcc_13: library, hooked test, production test, and benchmark passed with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror
correctness_and_build_gates.strict_clang_18: library, hooked test, production test, and benchmark passed with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror

correctness_and_build_gates.runner_tests: normal Python, python -O, py_compile, dependency-integrity, shared-inode, equal-path, and symmetric-argument tests passed
correctness_and_build_gates.benchmark_mode_validation: mode 0 and 1 emitted the expected schemas and markers; all other integer values fail before timing
oracles: exact Leopard main benchmark round trip and workload digests

K=8 at B=1023, B=1025, and B=2048 fallback
scratch, metadata, null, overlap, and failure-atomicity checks

resource_policy.reason_for_less_than_host_parallelism: Prior OOMs required serialized capped compiler and sanitizer work; authoritative cache-sensitive timing pinned CPU14 and reserved sibling CPU30. Read-only source, runner, and binary audits ran concurrently.

reproduce.freeze: install -m 0555 <external-build>/bench_leopard2 <frozen>/a/benchmark && ln <frozen>/a/benchmark <frozen>/b/benchmark; place exact-main benchmark at an equal-length path and verify SHA-256 plus shared device/inode

next_experiment: Reconfirm and then close the GF8 legacy-high K=7/R=4/B=1024 gap against exact Leopard main using the corrected shared-inode symmetric-argument methodology.
disposition: Promoted. Both new B=1024 cells credibly exceed the five-percent threshold versus same-source fallback and exact Leopard main; the retained B=512 cells remain faster, all predeclared same-path controls remain within two percent, parity and contract tests pass, and production library executable growth is 64 bytes with no backend-body change.
